docs(transport): document the list frames in the protocol spec

Adds § 4.3 list_sessions and § 5.9 session_list to the WebSocket protocol
spec: the frame tables, the authorisation rule (the user id comes from the
connection, never the frame), the validator constraints, the off-the-lock
answering beside ping, and the GDPR note. A new messageHandler test pins the
off-lock claim the spec now makes: a list_sessions sent while a user_message
is streaming is answered before that turn's stream_end. The conversation-list
spec already carried its section.

Also repairs the red build: the validator table is built from pairs, since
its snake_case wire-name keys are identifiers the camelcase rule refuses;
drainEngines binds wss to a local, so the client-count check is two member
hops instead of three; and the abandon-on-close suite carries an explicit
15s budget, because a server stop closes sockets by the close handshake and
waits on the client, which a loaded CI runner can make slower than jest's
default 5s - the third test timed out there. Anchors repointed for the
messageHandler suite shift.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

Refs re-cinq/HALEngine#144
